findings.problem: Temporal calibration materializes examples and predicts from base models before complete population/membership preflight.
findings.repair: Validate bounded typed complete fold and examples before any base read or allocation.

findings.problem: Observation evidence can end before the definition cut; candidate object version and optional definition identities are not fully bound/typed.
findings.repair: Reject pre-origin evidence and object-version mismatches, enforce exact optional identity types; preserve frozen schemas.

findings.problem: Unknown-order gap enumeration has no exact bounded batch/state/transition-work preflight.
findings.repair: Validate batch<=8 and state<=4096 limits; precharge factorial transitions against65536 before enumeration.

findings.problem: Final process CPU/wall/RSS may exceed limits after last sampled check without changing success.
findings.repair: Check final finite resources against retained180CPU/190hard/4GiB/240wall contract before success and attachment.

findings.problem: Strict interval containment cannot admit an actually observed event exactly at the closed decision cut when coverage ends at that cut; opening-prefix certification has the same boundary error.
findings.repair: Admit the exact observed endpoint without certifying future duration, preserve half-open requested end, and use consistent point/support logic in consumers.

findings.problem: Anchor capture hashes a MappingProxyType through a serializer that accepts dict only. Member binding also rejects legitimate late F09/anchor publication by comparing anchor cut with old source observation cut.
findings.repair: Use F10 supported canonical lineage hash; bind anchor formation to actual source membership and consumer publication, retaining independent source-cut/publication clocks.

findings.problem: Standardization and common fitted inference can accept caller values/context not joined to an actual same-row query ReadSession. Fit admission error classifications also disagree with predeclared future-fit vectors.
findings.repair: Require actual query reads for every public fitted query, validate schema/unit/row/cut/fold and actual fitted-upstream routes, compare exact configuration/context/epsilon, preserve intended future-start refusal.

findings.problem: Directional confirmation uses zero close with truthiness fallback, drops the first valid point after a gap, and later scale tuples have unchecked immutable representation.
findings.repair: Preserve zero explicitly, seed the new leg after a gap, freeze each leg threshold at actual birth, and validate the scale sequence without changing historical confirmation timing.

findings.problem: Public mutable book/version pointers and unauthenticated multiscale predecessor dictionaries permit forged histories; recursive memory predecessor validation can exceed bounded chain work.
findings.repair: Bind complete predecessor recipes to immutable history, validate books before mutation, use bounded iterative replay/cycle rejection and exact checkpoint byte limits.

findings.problem: At-extremum CVD sums all trades at the same timestamp and bar endpoints use interval start rather than the actual matching price event. Zero preceding scales reject raw-comparable cases.
findings.repair: Bind exact extremum event/order or expose ambiguity; select the actual within-bar extrema source; retain raw differences while zero normalized fields are null.

findings.problem: Breach comparison requires full future opportunity coverage and hides an already observed breach in a complete common prefix.
findings.repair: Intersect actual declared opportunities with known observed prefix, certify positive breach causally, and never infer absence across missing source support.

findings.problem: Residual basis permits bool/float/string Fraction coercion and inconsistent feature widths; fitted numeric query recipes need explicit retained observation bindings.
findings.repair: Require exact finite typed rational dimensions and source read joins; distinguish bounded numerical fit reconstruction from unimplemented producer/model claims.

findings.problem: Quote F02 matching checks only part of the F10 raw instrument definition; pressure/quote-origin semantics must distinguish a snapshot seed from an economic quote observation.
findings.repair: Validate full F02 identity/tick/lifetime and causal economic quote freshness; keep source-address/order and structural initial snapshot distinctions explicit.

findings.problem: New visit effort counts small price-observation prints that do not qualify under the frozen historical effort threshold. Pending markouts expose future extrema/source observations.
findings.repair: Count only newly eligible whole-print effort with original threshold/cohort; restrict all partial diagnostics to actually available future observations and keep mature fields null until complete.

findings.problem: Attempt summaries allow reuse of identical label outcomes under separate attempt IDs and freshness compares only the last receipt of an episode.
findings.repair: Reject duplicate label identities, maintain cumulative source sets for each original episode and preserve count of attempts versus independent episodes.

findings.problem: Profile multiscale persistence uses center-distance proximity in addition to overlap, and source proxy mass can treat unpriced volume as priced.
findings.repair: Use explicitly registered overlapping mode/basin correspondence; preserve unsupported/unpriced mass separately in each proxy and validate mass accounting.

findings.problem: Completed early brackets depend on whole developing-window completeness; TPO status can mark a completed uncovered bracket as merely provisional.
findings.repair: Certify each bracket from its own actual known interval support and relevant price/history facts; mark uncovered completed brackets missing; preserve final-tail gate.

findings.problem: Several explicit publication paths check capture availability but omit later anchor publication; transformed-recipe traversal and retained output byte bounds need consistent bounded admission.
findings.repair: Require max actual source/anchor computation availability, bound transform ancestry, and enforce registered source/retained byte/identity capacities at public boundaries.

findings.problem: CVD adapter indexes a tuple recipe as a dict and serializes private recipe state; divergence adapter unpacks three values into four names.
findings.repair: Use exact producer records and tuple recipe API; verify actual completed F10 publication for every supported producer.

findings.problem: Publication adapters validate sources only at historical capture time, so intervening known corrections can be published as current. Location-role corrections need actual old/new graph queries and original TTL proof.
findings.repair: Revalidate relevant actual source revisions at publication cut before mutation, keep original birth/anchor/expiry and reject stale available updates; extend real F10 correction tests.

findings.problem: IB adapter uses nonexistent FormationWindow.clock_variant_id; combined weekly variant has only a dependency placeholder and the test proves only distinct definition names.
findings.repair: Use clock_variant; assemble the explicitly declared first two eligible actual daily range formations, with actual calendar selection and no future second-day availability.

findings.problem: ReferenceGraph is mutable and does not revalidate its retained graph state before consensus/checkpoint; period/open byte/identity limits and scale high/low capabilities are incompletely checked.
findings.repair: Retain authentic bounded recipes, validate configuration/state before use, enforce every explicit local limit and required actual bar fields before arithmetic.

findings.problem: Pending gap diagnostics count future-unavailable points and coverage metadata; location label maturity can omit the original horizon when coverage ends early.
findings.repair: Restrict partial facts/counts to visible evidence, explicitly gate full outcomes at their frozen horizon/actual certification, retain censored state for incomplete evidence.

findings.problem: OI append checks only report/prior bytes while checkpoint also retains consumed IDs, queries and limits, so a valid append/observe can exceed configured checkpoint capacity.
findings.repair: Preflight the exact complete retained state for both mutations; preserve daily revision identity and monotone bounded replay semantics.

findings.problem: Initial fixtures have duplicate history_complete kwargs, an unsupported swing_snapshot reset_id argument, and correction/source shape mismatches; MD09 cohort print sizes contradict the frozen large10 result.
findings.repair: Repair only fixture construction/APIs; materialize small prints individually and assert the frozen cohort arithmetic; preserve original gold bytes.

findings.problem: MX03 currently selects4096 window events plus initial snapshot despite4096 total-input cap; MS11 lacks actual F09 correction replay, and some lag/visit/attempt cases initially asserted arithmetic alone.
findings.repair: Exercise exactly4096 total recipes and one-over; add actual F09 correction/reopen, authentic lag kernels, visit decay and attempt producers against independent primitive calculations.

findings.problem: DP05 mixes hard channels with soft knots; MF05 omits required CVD anchor and reads nonexistent high/low; future append passes dict to TradeLedger; MT11 coverage extends beyond cut.
findings.repair: Use real typed APIs and legal causal source fixtures without weakening expected values or intended violation gates.

findings.problem: MA01/MA05 do not yet cover exact1024 fit capacity/reopened serving; MP19 lacks actual correction path; MT10 combined weekly variant is a name-only check.
findings.repair: Add bounded actual positive/one-over fit cases and clean committed reopen; assert all frozen location roles/TTL after correction and both real weekly source constructions.

findings.problem: MR03 replaces nonexistent Session.version; MR12 builds invalid PublicationClock before intended missing-official gate; MR15/MR19/MR38/MR40 omit some frozen age/adversary/capacity variants.
findings.repair: Use source_version and otherwise valid clocks, assert every frozen scalar/isolated negative plus exact period/serialized capacities through real public operations.

findings.problem: M10 price-scale/zero-effort tests include an arithmetic-only surrogate alongside the new actual quote-origin fixture.
findings.repair: Make the actual F01/F02 quote and common trade producer assert frozen progress/ratio/zero-effort values and keep same-unit equivariance explicit.

findings.problem: Draft covered_mechanism values are lists while the normalizer requires a string; remaining-work fields include nonstring requirement records. Case presence alone cannot prove whole-source closure.
findings.repair: Normalize exact reviewed assertion bindings and honest source mechanisms/remaining work, keep all broad source closure false, and never equate method/name presence with test success.

findings.problem: Side/footprint sign and location exactness can be overstated with missing history or unknown directional mass; source derived recipe capacity claims need matching public tests.
findings.repair: Keep observed versus complete/certain support explicit; reject unsupported exact public roles and add actual per-family malformed/correction/capacity checks under the existing frozen cases.

method: Static source, API, frozen hand-vector and independent-reference trace; incorporates retained earlier independent reviews without repeating those passes.
positive_interface_checks: ObjectRevision.roles is an actual supported tuple.
MemoryDefinition decay_clock=visits is a declared supported spelling.
scope: All initial M01-M13 implementations plus shared location/label/decision/orchestration integration
